messages:
elaine (fintech-cust): Hey team — our March invoice jumped by ~38% but our client-side SDK estimator shows almost no change. Can we get a quick explain? We have a repro (short) below.

sam (support): Sorry about the surprise, can you paste the exact request you sent? SDK + server logs help.

elaine (fintech-cust): Here — using node SDK v0.9.2, code:
```js
const res = await Redwood.chat.create({
  model: 'rwd-4x',
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'You are concise.' },
    { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this transaction history...' }
  ],
  stream: true
});
// estimator: tokens = 62
```
and we did a curl repro (no stream):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4x","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this transaction history..."}],"stream":true}'
```

sam (support): Thanks. Two quick things we check: 1) hidden server-side injections (tool responses, assistant system messages) can add tokens; 2) streaming + client disconnects can lead to partial/duplicated server billing if we retry at transport layer. Do you have server request_id or a raw response with the stream events?

elaine (fintech-cust): I've attached a short raw stream capture from our proxy (snip):
```
event: data
data: {\"id\":\"...\",\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"role\":\"assistant\"}}]}
event: data
data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"Search results:\\n1) ...\"}}]}
event: data
data: {\"choices\":[{\"delta\":{\"role\":\"tool\",\"name\":\"kb_search\",\"content\":\"Found 3 docs\"}}]}
```
Estimator didn't count the tool role or tool content.

ingrid (eng-reliability): This matches a known gap — client SDK local tokenizer only counts the user/system/assistant content you send/receive as visible messages. It purposely omits server-inserted 'tool' role tokens and any on-the-fly moderation/system tokens unless the SDK materializes them into the final message. Server-side usage is computed from the canonical conversation we stitch together (includes tool responses, extra system text, and function outputs). Streaming can also generate additional tokens if the model produces intermediate tool calls then later the assistant content — the SDK estimator may undercount because it doesn't replay tool deltas.

julia (devex): Short repro step for customers:
1) run curl with `stream=false` and capture the final response JSON — compare estimator vs `usage.total_tokens` in the API response (we expose it in the response body for non-streaming). 
2) For streaming, enable server usage header `X-RWD-Total-Tokens` (temporary flag for support) or capture server-side request_id and ask support to fetch canonical usage for that request.

sam (support): @david can billing look up request_id 0a1b2c3d from elaine (they DM'ed it). We may want to issue a credit while we investigate.

david (billing): Got it — pulled the canonical usage for request_id 0a1b2c3d: api_reported_total_tokens=1474, customer_estimate=512. We can see repeated stream reconnects (3 attempts) and a tool response of ~600 tokens that SDK didn't count. I'll put a provisional credit of the difference while we confirm root cause. :white_check_mark:

elaine (fintech-cust): thanks. Two follow-ups: is there a way to make our estimator closer to server counts so we can alert earlier? Also curious if retries are avoidable.

ingrid (eng-reliability): Actionable guidance:
- If you rely on local estimates, also log `response_id` for each call and reconcile against server usage daily.
- Prefer non-streaming for accurate client-visible token counts (server returns usage.total_tokens). 
- If streaming, materialize tool deltas into your local estimator by concatenating all deltas (role/tool/content) as they arrive before computing tokens.
- Watch for retries in your HTTP client — set idempotency / single-try for chat streams or dedupe by `x-request-id` on reconnect.

julia (devex): I'll add a quick snippet to the SDK docs showing how to stitch stream deltas and compute a more accurate estimate. Filing PR: docs/sdk/stream-token-estimate.md

sam (support): I'll mark this ticket as high-priority for billing reconciliation. @elaine we should be good with provisional credit; we'll follow up once engineering confirms no double-billing bug.

elaine (fintech-cust): appreciate it. :pray:

sam (support): closing thread here but keeping ticket open until ingrid confirms fix/path. Thanks everyone.
